mapper.insert: insert into doctor_info(user_id, real_name, department, hospital, title, audit_status) values (#{userId},#{realName},#{department},#{hospital},#{title},'wait')
mapper.select: select di.*, u.username, u.role, u.status from doctor_info di left join sys_user u on di.user_id = u.id where di.audit_status = 'wait'
mapper.update: update doctor_info set real_name = #{info.realName}, department = #{info.department}, title = #{info.title}, hospital = #{info.hospital} where user_id = #{info.userId}
update doctor_info set real_name = #{realName}, department = #{department}, hospital = #{hospital}, title = #{title}, audit_status = #{auditStatus} where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select user_id, real_name, department, hospital, title from doctor_info where audit_status = 'pass' order by real_name asc
select user_id, real_name, department, hospital, title from doctor_info where audit_status = 'pass' and department = #{department} order by real_name asc
